stories.short: RIS ventes record PRT + reassurance longevite UK
stories.story_fr: Le segment Retirement and Income Solutions a realise des ventes record en 2025, incluant 14,2 Mds $ de transferts de risque retraite (PRT) et 11,1 Mds $ de reassurance longevite au Royaume-Uni.
stories.story_en: Retirement and Income Solutions delivered record full-year 2025 sales, including $14.2 billion in PRT transactions and $11.1 billion of U.K. longevity reinsurance.
stories.signal: RIS record sales, including transactions of $14.2 billion in PRT and $11.1 billion of U.K. longevity reinsurance.

stories.short: 12 Mds $ de mandats PRT securises au T4
stories.story_fr: MetLife a securise 12 Mds $ de mandats de transfert de risque retraite (PRT) sur le debut du quatrieme trimestre, renforcant le pipeline de son segment retraite.
stories.story_en: MetLife secured $12 billion in pension risk transfer mandates in the fourth quarter to-date, strengthening its retirement platform pipeline.
stories.signal: Secured $12 billion in PRT mandates in the fourth quarter to-date.

stories.short: Ventes Asie +34% en devise constante, Japon +31%
stories.story_fr: Les ventes en Asie ont progresse de 34% en devise constante au troisieme trimestre 2025, avec un Japon en hausse de 31% porte par de nouveaux produits orientes retraite.
stories.story_en: Asia sales grew 34% on a constant currency basis in Q3 2025, with Japan up 31%, reflecting new retirement-oriented products.
stories.signal: Grew Asia sales 34% on a constant currency basis, with Japan up 31%, reflecting new retirement-oriented products.

stories.short: Xcelerator : partenariat Mercado Libre Bresil et Mexique
stories.story_fr: MetLife a etendu sa plateforme numerique Xcelerator en Amerique latine via un nouveau partenariat avec Mercado Libre au Bresil et au Mexique.
stories.story_en: MetLife expanded its Xcelerator digital platform in Latin America through a new partnership with Mercado Libre in Brazil and Mexico.
stories.signal: Expanded MetLife Xcelerator in Latin America through a new partnership with Mercado Libre in Brazil and Mexico.

stories.short: Reassurance Talcott : ~10 Mds $ de rentes variables
stories.story_fr: MetLife a conclu en avril un accord avec une filiale de Talcott Financial Group pour reassurer environ 10 Mds $ de reserves de rentes variables et riders du marche americain.
stories.story_en: MetLife entered an agreement with a Talcott Financial Group subsidiary to reinsure approximately $10 billion of U.S. retail variable annuity and rider reserves.
stories.signal: Entered into an agreement with a subsidiary of Talcott Financial Group to reinsure approximately $10 billion of U.S. retail variable annuity and rider reserves in April.
